fields.description: Thymio II is an open-source educational mobile robot designed by EPFL researchers with ECAL and produced by Mobsya. The manufacturer lists 11 x 11.2 x 5.3 cm dimensions, 270 g mass, a 3.7 V 1,500 mAh Li-Po battery with more than two hours of autonomy, a 14 cm/s maximum speed, nine infrared sensors, five capacitive touch buttons, an accelerometer, thermometer, microphone, infrared receiver, 39 controllable LEDs, two wheel motors and a speaker. fields.description: ROAMEO is RAD Security’s autonomous outdoor security patrol robot for parking lots, campuses and industrial sites. The 1,800 lb (816 kg) vehicle carries five solid-state 3D LiDAR sensors, cameras, GPS and an IMU, follows mapped lanes with geofences and safe-stop, and can climb 15° slopes in temperatures from -4°F to 113°F (-20°C to 45°C). It patrols up to 16 hours and 80 miles per charge at up to 10 mph, auto-docks, and sends events to SARA Agentic AI and RADSOC for verification, escalation and fleet control. RAD sells ROAMEO as a monthly service with a site-specific quote. No numeric price, dimensions beyond the published envelope, payload, IP rating, navigation accuracy or release year is published.

fields.description: Rapid Robotics 3PRO is an industrial humanoid with two arms, a stable base that operators can reposition on the factory floor and a mobile base in development. Rapid positions it as a general-purpose robot with the footprint of a human that can perform multiple tasks at different locations, replacing fixed single-process arms and bulky frames. The robot integrates PickNik MoveIt Pro for motion planning, grasping, perception, behaviour sequencing and digital-twin simulation. Rapid says the design supports heavy payloads, fast and precise movement and multi-task operation; the case study publishes no numeric price, mass, dimensions, payload, speed, battery endurance, runtime, degrees of freedom, IP rating, navigation accuracy or release date.

fields.description: REV-1 is Refraction AI’s three-wheel autonomous last-mile delivery robot. The company announced an Austin pilot on June 14, 2021 with ten robots serving South Congress, Downtown and Travis Heights. It stands 4.5 ft tall, is 4.5 ft long and 30 in wide, weighs approximately 150 lb, reaches up to 15 mph and carries a 16 cubic foot cargo compartment holding about six grocery bags. It operates primarily in bike lanes or at the roadside and can use traffic lanes and sidewalks where permitted. Customers receive SMS updates and a unique code for curbside collection. Refraction launched in July 2019 and previously operated in Ann Arbor. No numeric price, battery endurance, runtime, payload mass, IP rating, navigation accuracy or per-unit production date is published.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: Thymio II is one educational mobile robot; the current Thymio 2+ and Thymio 3 pages are separate products and their figures are not merged into Thymio II. RAD ROAMEO is one patrol vehicle; SARA and RADSOC are software layers, not separate robots. Rapid 3PRO is one dual-arm industrial humanoid; the in-development mobile base is a configuration of the same robot. Refraction REV-1 is one three-wheel delivery robot; the Austin fleet of ten is deployment, not ten models.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: No reviewed page publishes a numeric Thymio II, ROAMEO, 3PRO or REV-1 price. Thymio directs buyers to resellers and RAD sells a monthly quoted service; the catalog Thymio "100 EUR" value is not supported by the reviewed pages and is cleared.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: Thymio publishes 270 g. RAD publishes 1,800 lb (816 kg). Refraction publishes approximately 150 lb. No 3PRO mass is published; "heavy payloads" is not a numeric mass.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: Thymio publishes 11 x 11.2 x 5.3 cm. RAD publishes L 71.2 in x W 47.6 in x H 80 in. Refraction publishes 4.5 ft long x 30 in wide x 4.5 ft tall. No 3PRO dimensions are published; "footprint of a human" is qualitative.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed page publishes a numeric payload mass for Thymio II, ROAMEO, 3PRO or REV-1. Refraction publishes a 16 cubic foot cargo compartment and about six grocery bags; this is cargo volume/capacity, not a payload mass rating. Rapid mentions heavy payloads without a figure.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: Thymio publishes more than 2 hours of autonomy. RAD publishes up to 16 hours continuous and 80 mi per charge. No 3PRO or REV-1 battery endurance is published; REV-1 is described as fully electric without a runtime figure.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Thymio is a programmable educational mobile robot with preprogrammed behaviours and no autonomous navigation claim. ROAMEO follows mapped lanes autonomously with onboard detection and safe-stop. 3PRO is a dual-arm industrial humanoid on a stable repositionable base; its mobile base is in development. REV-1 is an autonomous three-wheel delivery robot operating in bike lanes, traffic lanes and sidewalks. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.
